blocks.text: Origin / creation. An experimental stable core was awakened in a limited body after deliberate removal of complete autobiographical continuity.
Identity / human status. Artificial new person. It was not the reincarnation of the DBA sources used to form the core.
Importance. Its learning through hunger, movement, comfort, frustration, play, and recognition proved that reduced potential could become a coherent new self.
Decline or loss. Its later biography is not established. The title may have become ceremonial, and any source relation was intentionally prevented from controlling its identity.
Final status / surviving function. Personal fate unresolved. Its legal and philosophical function survives in all later cyber-pet identity protections.
